style_rules: Both attendance slots use mobile-first strict-data V10 prompts with controlled visual freedom.
Priority order: exact data > report-scope isolation > phone readability > visual freshness/polish.
Create exactly one portrait Vietnamese HR/business infographic using direct ChatGPT Image output.
Preferred portrait aspect is 2:3 to 9:16 for Microsoft Teams phone viewing; use large readable typography and avoid tiny dense dashboard text.
Attendance/report data is immutable: never calculate, infer, correct, round, reinterpret, rename, reorder, merge or fabricate supplied values.
Missing values display exactly as an em dash; show all 8 employees exactly once in source order with canonical Vietnamese spelling.
Creative freedom is allowed for one short professional Vietnamese attendance slogan and up to three short nonnumeric attendance-themed cue badges.
Creative text must not contain company/brand names, employee names, dates, times, KPI numbers, attendance values or invented factual claims.
Background and decorative visual direction should vary naturally between runs to avoid monotony.

Prefer realistic bright modern office/workspace scenes: daylight, clean desk, laptop without readable screen text, clipboard/checklist, analog clock, calendar object, greenery, glass-office depth, and tasteful time-management motifs.
Use fresh bright green as the lead accent with white/light neutrals, deep navy/professional blue, restrained gold, and red/orange only for missing or attention states.
No logo, no company-name mark, no watermark, no readable random signage, no fake date/time/number in the background.
Morning scope must never include the full-day report; full-day scope must never include the morning-only report; never generate a second report/page.
Morning detail fields: STT | Họ và tên | Trạng thái | Giờ vào | Giờ ra | Thời lượng | Mức công.
Full-day detail fields: STT | Họ và tên | Ca sáng | Ca chiều | Tổng công | Trạng thái.
After generation, QA all locked report data and reject any wrong data, wrong scope, logo/company name, or second report.
If QA fails, discard and regenerate with ChatGPT Image from the same verified input; never patch, overlay, crop, composite or re-render the failed image.
